defs.def: to feel sorry about sth you have done or about sth that you have not been able to do 感到遗憾；惋惜；懊悔

ex.s: her parents might regret selling their house
ex.t: 她的父母可能会后悔卖掉房子。

ex.s: The end result is a read in which we learn to wonder like Socrates, see like Thoreau, listen like Schopenhauer, and have no regrets like Nietzsche.
ex.t: 最终读到的，是我们学会像苏格拉底一样发问、像梭罗一样观察、像叔本华一样倾听、像尼采一样无怨无悔。

ex.s: She regretted not doing enough warm up.
ex.t: 她后悔没有做足够的热身运动。

ex.s: But when he finally reached her, the woman flooded him with questions: "Who are you？What antique shop？" However, when she hung up, she regretted the way she had handled the call.
ex.t: 但当他终于联系上她时，这位女士连珠炮似地问了他很多问题："你是谁？哪家古董店？"然而，当她挂断电话后，她后悔自己处理这次通话的方式。

ex.s: Now we live in a world surrounded by the "can't do" attitudes． We all fall down． We all have doubts and regrets． Still we must climb and dream about what's at the top of our mountain． Monsters may appear or the night will fall． But never ever give up on your dream!
ex.t: 如今我们生活在一个被“做不到”态度包围的世界。我们都会跌倒。我们都有疑虑和悔恨。但我们仍须攀登，梦想山顶的风景。怪物可能出现，夜幕可能降临。但永远不要放弃你的梦想！

ex.s: Instead of looking back with regret, we should be facing our future with energy and optimism, for the choices are ours, and ours only.
ex.t: 我们不应该带着遗憾回顾过去，而应该充满活力和乐观地面对未来，因为选择权在我们自己手里，且只在我们自己手里。

ex.s: Robert The Road Not Taken is one of America’s best-loved poems, and I think it is a pity that it is generally misunderstood as a call for facing the future without regret.
ex.t: 罗伯特：《未选择的路》是美国最受喜爱的诗歌之一，我认为很可惜它通常被误解为是一首号召人们不留遗憾地面对未来的诗。

defs.def: （有礼貌地或正式地表示抱歉、痛惜或悲伤）

ex.s: I don‘t want to regret things when I‘m old!
ex.t: 我不想在老的时候后悔！

chunks.en: regret things / facing / climb / way / selling
chunks.cn: 感到遗憾事情 / 感到遗憾脸 / 感到遗憾爬 / 感到遗憾方式 / 感到遗憾卖
